svg.title: 3C orchestration: skills dispatch agents, agents never dispatch
svg.desc: A person invokes a skill. /3c-programme-manager runs /3c-project-manager per project in dependency order. /3c-project-manager runs a scope pre-check with 3c-product-owner and 3c-journey-architect, implements with /3c-implement, which drafts tests through /3c-test and 3c-test-author and reviews with /3c-review, then cross-checks with /3c-review-board, whose agents report to 3c reconcile for one verdict. /3c-retrospective is optional after shipping.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Board · in parallel, plus 3c-product-owner with AC context
